verdict.rationale: Gitea ships its own automation engine. Gitea Actions provides GitHub Actions-compatible CI/CD workflows written in YAML, can reuse existing Actions, and supports Kubernetes autoscaling runners, so users can define workflows that run unattended. The evidence describes this only at a high level, though, and nothing shows scheduled or event-driven background runs or agentic automation. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/cron and event triggers, AI-agent-driven background automation, in-depth docs on runner behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions running autonomously.
